currentAdult.dateCaveat: Historical capture selected by the subject as current-adult likeness authority; capture date is not asserted as 2026.
identityUse: hair and facial-hair presentation when visible
neck tattoo placement and character when visible
limitations: not sufficient by itself for full-body motion Gold Master
not sufficient by itself for multi-view high-resolution head reconstruction

historical.rule: Never substitute historical Adam for current-adult launch identity.

generatedDerived.rule: No generated or reconstructed result can supersede real-source identity authority without literal comparison, provenance, and human approval.

identityRules: Do not beautify or genericize the subject.
Preserve visible asymmetry and distinguishing features.
Do not invent tattoo detail beyond visible evidence.
Do not infer biometric identity from unrelated images.
Do not expose private source media in public GitHub or client bundles.
All derivatives must retain source hash lineage and synthetic/real classification.

presentationAuthority.description: Represent Adam as his stable current-adult identity on a rested, good day: natural, upright, healthy-looking, and recognizably Adam without de-aging, glamorizing, or changing body identity.
stableIdentityMustPreserve: glasses when part of intended launch appearance
tattoos supported by real source evidence
body proportions supported by multi-source real evidence
bodyPresentationRules: Do not make Adam appear heavier because of wide-angle distortion, slouching, clothing bunching, temporary puffiness, or a single unflattering capture.
Do not artificially slim, sculpt, de-age, or fitness-enhance Adam beyond stable real-source evidence.
Resolve body proportions from multiple real observations when available rather than one transient capture state.
Use upright relaxed posture and natural perspective as the neutral launch presentation.
presentationAuthority.captureTimingRule: A tired-day capture may be retained as provenance but must not define canonical rested-neutral presentation. New identity capture can wait until Adam is rested enough to represent the intended launch appearance.
